{{Quote|You'll be taking your personal shuttle, I presume.''"<br />"''That's right. The ''Victory'' over in hangar thirteen.|Chet and Darth Zannah|<ref name="doe" />}}
The '''''Theta''-class T-1 vessel''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] class manufactured by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] around [[980 BBY]]. [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]-capable and requiring a minimum crew of only one, it was the highest-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|priced]] and one of the most luxurious personal shuttles on the market at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] owned and [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] one of these [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], the [[Triumph (Theta-class T-1 vessel)|''Triumph'']]; as did his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], who flew in the [[Victory (Theta-class T-1 vessel)|''Victory'']].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Oh, yeah. I remember him. Nice ride. State-of-the-art shuttle. Custom interior. Top of the line. Even nicer than yours.|[[Pommat]], comparing Set Harth's shuttle to Zannah's ''Theta''-class T-1 vessel|<ref name="doe" />}}
''Theta''-class T-1 vessels were luxurious personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] produced by the manufacturing company [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]]. These [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] were equipped<ref name="doe" /> with an advanced<ref name="S&V 63">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|63|Action Stations}}</ref> [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and required only one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], although they could carry at least one other passenger. The shuttles were also outfitted with a private [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] channel and a sophisticated [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of its release, the ''Theta''-class T-1 vessel was the most expensive<ref name="doe" /> and luxurious<ref name="S&V 63" /> shuttle on the public market capable of [[Realspace/Legends|interplanetary]] travel.<ref name="doe" />

==History==
The ''Theta''-class T-1 vessel was created and released by Cygnus Spaceworks around [[980 BBY]], just twenty years [[1000 BBY/Legends|after]] the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|conclusion]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. The vessels became known for being the most modern and state-of-the-art interplanetary shuttles accessible on the open market at the time of their release. By 980 BBY, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] each owned their own ''Theta''-class T-1 vessel, which they used on multiple missions.<ref name="doe" />

===Notable vessels===
[[File:BaneZannah-DoE.png|thumb|right|200px|Darths Bane and Zannah, both of whom owned a ''Theta''-class T-1 vessel]]
{{Quote|You're going to stay here and guard the ship.|Darth Zannah, to Set Harth, on the ''Victory''|<ref name="doe" />}}
[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane owned and flew a ''Theta''-class T-1 vessel, which he named the [[Triumph (Theta-class T-1 vessel)|''Triumph'']], in 980 BBY. At this time, Bane, who lived in a [[Darth Bane's mansion|mansion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ciutric IV]], kept the shuttle in a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the nearby [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Daplona]]. He piloted the ''Triumph'' on a [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|mission]] to the planet [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] to recover the [[Holocron of Heresies|legendary holocron]] of [[Darth Andeddu]], from which he forcefully took the knowledge of [[essence transfer]] during the journey back to Ciutric IV.<ref name="doe" />

Darth Zannah possessed a ''Theta''-class T-1 vessel of her own, the [[Victory (Theta-class T-1 vessel)|''Victory'']], which she used during multiple operations. She flew the ship on a [[Mission to Doan|mission]] to [[Doan]], and subsequently to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to [[Duel in Set Harth's mansion|enlist]] the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] as her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] in preparation for dueling Bane for rites to [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Mastery]]. She flew with Harth back to Ciutric IV, where she found that Bane had been [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|captured]]. Zannah then took the ''Victory'' to [[Stone Prison|the prison]] on Doan to which Bane had been taken. While she [[Duel on Doan|dueled]] Bane in the [[Prison/Legends|prison]], Harth fled the facility in another shuttle. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] duel ended in a draw, and Zannah then piloted her shuttle to [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], where she met with Bane and defeated him in their [[Duel on Ambria (980 BBY)|final duel]]. When not flying the ship, Zannah kept the ''Victory'' at the spaceport in Daplona, under the care of the [[Customs official/Legends|customs officer]] [[Chet]].<ref name="doe" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Theta''-class T-1 vessel was introduced in the final novel of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']], ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and released in [[2009]].<ref name="doe" />
